illustration.stableHeader: Use approved identity and style references. Preserve camera-specific layout, relative scale and current object states. Draw actual interaction and directed gaze; earn expressions from the action.

repair.stableHeader: Edit the selected source image only for the named defect. Keep unrelated composition, lighting, approved faces, objects and camera geometry.

storyboard.method: Layout existing selected art and caption; blank panel for unresolved image. This is a comparison artifact, not new image generation.
